title: 第一卷 第11章 谢寒声你混蛋第一卷 第12章 踩他的
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了

一大早上被扰了清梦，还被劈头盖脸一顿责备，舒晩昭的瞌睡虫醒了一半，头顶发丝凌乱地竖起，浑身上下每一根头发丝都散发着不爽的气息。
她一脸懵地扶着门，又挠了挠头，低头看一眼。
唔，是修真界很平淡的白色里衣，外面披了一件浅红色袍子。
乱是乱了点，但该露的不该露的都没有露啊。
她一脸匪夷所思，都修仙世界了，思想这么保守的吗？？
她双目眯了眯，如同闻到荤腥的猫，不仅没有回去换衣服，反而笑眯眯地晃到他脸对着的方向。
恶劣地倒打一耙，“二师兄一大早上来吵醒我睡觉，不会就是想看我衣衫不整的模样吧？”
此时此刻，舒晩昭的头顶仿佛冒出来一对儿恶魔的小犄角，心里阴恻恻地桀桀桀。
啊嘿，她不会放过任何欺负他的手段。
果然，随着她的靠近，男人眼睛都不知道放哪了，应激似的后退一步。
那一瞬间，舒晩昭就像是一只邪恶的银渐层，眨着无辜的大眼睛邪恶逼近。
嘴里念念有词：“二师兄你怎么不说话，也不看我，是师妹我长得丑吗？”
随着她的靠近，独属于女子的馨香似有似无地钻进鼻腔。
男人浑身肌肉紧绷得像一块块堆积的石头，冷冰冰的一张冰块脸，活像是吞了十个唐僧，一副不解风情，又拿女施主无可奈何的模样。
他从喉间挤出的两个字：“不丑。”
声音如同生锈的机器，干涩，生硬。
“那就是我好看咯？”
他们彼此的距离不断缩减，她几乎是靠在了他身上，中间只隔了布料，更何况她的衣袍凌乱，几缕青丝搭在肩头，从谢寒声的角度，还能看见她发丝下纤白的脖颈。
他的视线被烫了一下，迅速收回。

一把冷硬的剑柄，抵住了女子的肩头，仿佛按下了关闭键，将人固定在原地。
“师妹，男女授受不亲，你不能这样。”他别开脸，面色冷峻，不近人情，“回去。”
他的剑横在二人之间，微微出鞘，露出森冷的寒芒。差点晃瞎了舒晩昭的眼。
舒晩昭：“！”一言不合就上剑，玩不起是不是？
她立即老实了，吞了吞口水，瓮声瓮气：“知道了，小古板一个，不经逗，快放我回去，我去换衣服。”
她被定住了身，动不了，只有眼尾上扬出不服输的弧度，尽显俏皮。
谢寒声抿了抿唇瓣，剑柄在她身上一点，背过身子，冷冷地开口：“去吧。”
舒晩昭磨磨蹭蹭换衣服洗漱。
再次出门，一身明艳的黄裙，领口绣着一串娇嫩的金兰花，从曼妙的曲线延伸到浅绿色的腰封，腰间点缀了一圈玉组佩和一些小铃铛，踩着金缕靴叮叮当当地就出来了。
她迈着轻盈的小步伐，抬头一看，某个刻板的男人还背对着她，肩宽窄臀，背脊笔直如剑，墨发竖起，发梢微卷，气场冷淡孤寂。
大概是听到她的动静，他侧头，侧脸的骨相卓越，眉弓丰满，鼻梁如峰，确定她衣衫整齐，才彻底转过身来。
但还是被她这身打扮弄得愣了一下，抿着唇，板着脸思考，“师妹，你这身练剑不大方便。”
舒晩昭：“？”
她一个踉跄，站定在原地，
不死心地问：“练剑？练什么剑？”
谢寒声一板一眼，“昨日，你和大师兄说要我教你练剑，我都听见了。”
“……”
呵呵，练剑是不可能练剑的，这辈子都不可能练剑，舒晩昭脚底抹油，迅速溜走，结果下一秒，就被男人薅住了，揪回来。
“师妹，时辰不早了，该练剑了。”

After being disturbed from his dream early in the morning and being scolded, Shu Zhaozhao woke up half way through his sleepiness. The hair on his head stood up messily, and every hair on his body exuded an unpleasant smell.
She held the door in confusion, scratched her head again, and looked down.
Well, it's a very plain white undergarment in the world of cultivation, with a light red robe on the outside.
It's a bit messy, but nothing that should be exposed or shouldn't be exposed is not exposed.
She looked incredulous. She had already cultivated into the world of immortality. How could she be so conservative in her thoughts? ?
Her eyes narrowed, like a cat smelling something fishy. Not only did she not go back to change clothes, but she smiled in the direction his face was facing.
He slapped him harshly, "Second Senior Brother came to wake me up early in the morning. Did he just want to see how disheveled I am?"
At this moment, Shu Mingzhao seemed to have a pair of devil's little horns sprouting from his head, and his heart was filled with sadness.
Ah hey, she won't let go of any means to bully him.
Sure enough, as she approached, the man's eyes didn't know where to look, and he took a step back as if in a hurry.
At that moment, Shu Mingzhao was like an evil silver layer, blinking its big innocent eyes and approaching evilly.
He muttered something: "Second Senior Brother, why don't you speak or look at me? Am I ugly, Junior Sister?"
As she got closer, the fragrant fragrance that belongs only to women penetrated into the nostrils.
The muscles all over the man's body were as tight as piles of stones, and his face was as cold as ice, as if he had swallowed ten Tang monks. He looked confused and helpless with the female benefactor.
The two words he squeezed out from his throat were: "Not ugly."
The sound was like a rusty machine, dry and stiff.
"That means I'm good-looking?"
The distance between them continued to shrink, and she was almost leaning on him, with only cloth between them. What's more, her robe was messy, with a few strands of green silk hanging on her shoulders. From Xie Hansheng's angle, she could still see her white neck under the hair.
His vision was burned and he quickly retracted it.
A cold and hard sword hilt pressed against the woman's shoulder, as if pressing a shutdown button, fixing the woman in place.
"Junior sister, men and women are not close to each other, you can't do this." He turned his face away, his face was cold and inhumane, "Go back."
His sword lay between the two of them, slightly unsheathed, revealing a cold light. It almost blinded Shu Mingzhao.
Shu Mingzhao: "!" If you don't agree with each other, you will take up the sword. You can't afford it, right?
She immediately became honest, swallowed her saliva, and said in a deep voice: "I know, I'm a little old-fashioned. If you don't tease me, please let me go back. I'll go change clothes."
She was frozen and unable to move. Only the ends of her eyes were raised in an unyielding arc, showing her playfulness.
Xie Hansheng pursed her lips, put the hilt of the sword on her body, turned his back, and said coldly: "Go."
Shu Minzhao took his time changing clothes and washing up.
Going out again, she wore a bright yellow dress with a string of delicate golden orchids embroidered on the neckline, extending from the graceful curves to the light green girdle. The waist was embellished with a circle of jade pendants and some small bells, and she stepped out with jingling golden boots.
She took light steps and looked up. She saw a stereotyped man with his back to her. He had broad shoulders and narrow hips, his back was as straight as a sword, his black hair stood up, slightly curled at the ends, and he had a cold and lonely aura.
Probably hearing her movement, he turned his head. The profile of his face was of outstanding bones, the eyebrows were plump, and the bridge of his nose was like a peak. He made sure that her clothes were neat and tidy before turning around completely.
But he was still stunned by her outfit. He pursed his lips and thought with a straight face, "Junior sister, it's not convenient for you to practice swordsmanship in this outfit."
Shu Mingzhao: "?"
She staggered and stood still.
He asked without giving up: "Sword training? What kind of sword training?"
Xie Hansheng said sternly, "Yesterday, you told senior brother that you wanted me to teach you how to practice swordsmanship. I heard everything."
"..."
Haha, it’s impossible to practice swordsmanship. You won’t be able to practice swordsmanship in this life.Maybe he was practicing swordplay, so he rubbed oil on his soles and quickly slipped away. However, the next second, he was grabbed by the man and dragged back.
"Junior sister, it's getting late, it's time to practice sword practice."
